verdict.rationale: The docs show one account-level API key used as a bearer token, plus an OAuth connection for ChatGPT, but nothing documents scoped, read-only, or least-privilege credentials that could be issued to an agent. The adjacent items don't qualify: GraphQL field selection, some MCP tools being read-only, and Super Admin keys that bypass privacy settings all describe something other than credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
